spec.title: GLPI Projects
spec.description: Indicadores consolidados de situação e progresso de projetos e tarefas.

spec.rawSql:
-- Current snapshot: all valid projects in the selected entity scope.
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value
FROM glpi_projects AS p
WHERE p.is_deleted = 0
  AND p.is_template = 0
  AND p.entities_id IN ($entity);

spec.description: Projetos em estados não finalizados que não são de não iniciados nem pausados, incluindo fases intermediárias.

spec.rawSql:
-- Current snapshot: valid projects in progress, including intermediate phases.
-- Status groups (verified in TEST and production): finished = is_finished = 1;
-- not started = A Fazer (TEST) or Não Inicializado (production); paused = name contains 'paus';
-- in progress = any other non-finished state; no state = projectstates_id 0 or missing state.
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value
FROM glpi_projects AS p
JOIN glpi_projectstates AS ps
     ON ps.id = p.projectstates_id
WHERE p.is_deleted = 0
  AND p.is_template = 0
  AND p.entities_id IN ($entity)
  AND p.projectstates_id <> 0
  AND ps.is_finished = 0
  AND COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(ps.name)), '') NOT IN ('a fazer', 'não inicializado')
  AND COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(ps.name)), '') NOT LIKE '%paus%';

spec.description: Projetos cujo estado está marcado como finalizado.

spec.rawSql:
-- Current snapshot: valid projects whose state is marked finished.
-- Status groups (verified in TEST and production): finished = is_finished = 1;
-- not started = A Fazer (TEST) or Não Inicializado (production); paused = name contains 'paus';
-- in progress = any other non-finished state; no state = projectstates_id 0 or missing state.
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value
FROM glpi_projects AS p
JOIN glpi_projectstates AS ps
     ON ps.id = p.projectstates_id
WHERE p.is_deleted = 0
  AND p.is_template = 0
  AND p.entities_id IN ($entity)
  AND p.projectstates_id <> 0
  AND ps.is_finished = 1;

spec.description: Projetos no estado A Fazer ou Não Inicializado.

spec.rawSql:
-- Current snapshot: valid projects not started yet.
-- Status groups (verified in TEST and production): finished = is_finished = 1;
-- not started = A Fazer (TEST) or Não Inicializado (production); paused = name contains 'paus';
-- in progress = any other non-finished state; no state = projectstates_id 0 or missing state.
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value
FROM glpi_projects AS p
JOIN glpi_projectstates AS ps
     ON ps.id = p.projectstates_id
WHERE p.is_deleted = 0
  AND p.is_template = 0
  AND p.entities_id IN ($entity)
  AND p.projectstates_id <> 0
  AND ps.is_finished = 0
  AND LOWER(TRIM(ps.name)) IN ('a fazer', 'não inicializado');

-- Current snapshot: valid projects without a state (projectstates_id 0 or a missing state).
-- Status groups (verified in TEST and production): finished = is_finished = 1;
-- not started = A Fazer (TEST) or Não Inicializado (production); paused = name contains 'paus';
-- in progress = any other non-finished state; no state = projectstates_id 0 or missing state.
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value
FROM glpi_projects AS p
LEFT JOIN glpi_projectstates AS ps
       ON ps.id = p.projectstates_id
WHERE p.is_deleted = 0
  AND p.is_template = 0
  AND p.entities_id IN ($entity)
  AND ps.id IS NULL;

spec.description: Média do percent_done dos projetos em andamento. Não é uma taxa de conclusão.

spec.rawSql:
-- Average stored progress (percent_done) of valid projects in progress.
-- Status groups (verified in TEST and production): finished = is_finished = 1;
-- not started = A Fazer (TEST) or Não Inicializado (production); paused = name contains 'paus';
-- in progress = any other non-finished state; no state = projectstates_id 0 or missing state.
SELECT AVG(p.percent_done) AS average_progress
FROM glpi_projects AS p
JOIN glpi_projectstates AS ps
     ON ps.id = p.projectstates_id
WHERE p.is_deleted = 0
  AND p.is_template = 0
  AND p.entities_id IN ($entity)
  AND p.projectstates_id <> 0
  AND ps.is_finished = 0
  AND COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(ps.name)), '') NOT IN ('a fazer', 'não inicializado')
  AND COALESCE(LOWER(TRIM(ps.name)), '') NOT LIKE '%paus%';

WHERE pt.is_deleted = 0
  AND pt.is_template = 0
  AND p.is_deleted = 0
  AND p.is_template = 0
  AND p.entities_id IN ($entity);
